banners.prompt:
Create a photorealistic product mockup of a printed paperback book standing slightly angled, turned a little to the LEFT so that we see the front cover and the white page edges on the RIGHT side of the book. The spine is NOT visible: no spine, no back cover and no text anywhere except the front cover. Physically correct perspective like a real product photo on a pure white background, soft natural shadow under it. The book fills about 75% of the frame height and is fully visible, nothing cropped.
FRONT COVER DESIGN - "living room mat": sand beige background with a soft sage band at the top. A photorealistic bright scene: a woman about 45-50 doing a gentle pilates side-plank / leg lift on a teal yoga mat in a cosy sunny living room with a sofa and a plant, calm smile. Title in deep teal, "НАД 40" in coral.
TEXT ON THE COVER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Title, huge, 2-4 lines: "ПИЛАТЕС ВКЪЩИ ЗА ЖЕНИ НАД 40"
2) Subtitle, smaller, 4-5 lines: "28-дневната програма C.O.R.E. - 60 упражнения за стегнат корем, здрав гръб и повече енергия за 15 минути на ден, без фитнес, без уреди и без предишен опит."
3) Author name at the bottom of the cover, medium: "ДАНИЕЛА ПЕТРОВА"
4) Publisher mark at the very bottom centre, small: a simple golden key icon followed by the words "ЗЛАТЕН КЛЮЧ"
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic except "C.O.R.E.". Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Heavy, clean modern sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style) for titles; clean regular sans-serif for the subtitle. Large and clearly legible on a phone.
- No other text, other logos, watermarks, prices or website addresses anywhere.
STYLE: premium, modern, bright, calm and confident bestselling fitness/wellbeing book design, NOT a gym or bodybuilding look, NOT sexualised, NOT childish, no clip-art. Palette: soft sage green #8FB9A8, warm coral #F08A6C, sand beige #F3E7D7, deep teal #1F5C5B and white.
The woman looks like an ordinary healthy Bulgarian woman about 45-50 (not a model, not a teenager), natural friendly face, modest comfortable sportswear (long leggings and a loose top), correct anatomy and hands with five fingers.
